'''Stiv McFadden''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Flatwoods tournament]] on 10 March 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Black Sun]], according to Coleman Richardson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ flatwoods-ky-3-10-01], DeckTech (Coleman "Crashman" Richardson, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
